'''Aglar Orin''' was a former [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. Reasoning that he should receive better pay if he were to continue to risk his life for his work, Orin resigned from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] at the end of his mandatory term of service, and began his career as a bounty hunter. Orin enjoyed the thrill of the hunt so much that the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] soon became unimportant to him, and he began to take extreme risks. Aglar Orin was a rugged braggart whose hunting skills were matched by his riotous behavior.
